title: 1808 Prairie's roof dormer gets a pediment
items: The dormer on 1808 Prairie's front roof now has a pediment: a moulded cornice across its face that turns back along both sides, and two stepped bands under the gable's edge.
To make room, the dormer stands about 20 cm taller; its window is the same size and the cornice is now its head.
Like the rest of the kit, it is newly designed: no picture of 1808's real roof has been read.
